The All Might Era.text: The All Might era is the press's name for the decades since All Might reached Number One, a period of falling villain crime that Japan credits largely to him. He debuted as a young pro with a disaster rescue that television still replays, climbed the chart quickly and has held the top spot ever since. Villain crime in Japan now sits far below the world average, and other countries study the Japanese system. Commentators call it a society held up by one pillar: would-be villains stay quiet because he might come. Fans divide his career into ages named after his costumes. Critics ask what Japan has stopped doing for itself while he holds it up, and whether the profession grew comfortable in his shadow.
